Scopely is looking for a 
Senior Associate Product Marketing Manager
 to join our Monopoly GO! Game in Culver City on a hybrid basis, working 2 days a week from the hub. 
 
At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. 
 
Monopoly GO! is a worldwide phenomenon, reaching tens of millions of players worldwide. This role is an opportunity to be part of a world-class team of marketers leading promotional efforts for a multi-billion-dollar game. The team is based in Canada, Europe and the US, and works every day to create captivating new experiences for our players.
What You Will Do
 
 
Support GTM planning and campaign execution across seasonal content, in-game events, new product features, and major IP collaboration launches, partnering with Product, LiveOps, UA, CRM, Community, and other cross-functional teams to keep launches on track and unblock execution.
Drive creative development for marketing campaigns, including trailers, key art, User Acquisition creatives, and other promotional assets. Act as the primary point of contact between internal creative teams, external agencies, and marketing stakeholders to manage timelines, feedback, approvals, and asset delivery.
Support app stores promotional initiatives, including featuring opportunities, in-app event cards,co-marketing campaigns across App Store and Google Play.
Support major IP collaborations, partnering closely with external licensors and internal stakeholders throughout campaign development. Serve as the primary point of contact for licensor reviews, approvals, and day-to-day communications to ensure assets meet partner guidelines and deadlines.
Become an expert in MONOPOLY GO!, its roadmap, and live operations, using deep product knowledge to support marketing initiatives, partnership opportunities, and cross-functional decision making.
 
What We’re Looking For 
 
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Advertising, or a related field.
Minimum 3 years of experience in product marketing, brand marketing, project management, or a similar role.
Passion for games and a strong desire to learn product marketing in a live-service environment.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.
A proactive, self-starter mindset with strong attention to detail and a willingness to take ownership of projects from planning through execution.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating across cross-functional teams and external partners.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and adapt as priorities shift.
Experience supporting creative development, marketing campaigns, or go-to-market initiatives is a plus.
Experience working with licensed IPs, platform partnerships (App Store/Google Play), or User Acquisition is a plus.
Experience within the gaming or entertainment industry is preferred but not required. Experience working on AAA or mobile games is a plus. 
 
At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that!   We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

Experience with casual or social games
Experience with game economy, balancing, segmentation, or LiveOps optimization

Scopely Explore is looking for an Executive Producer for Pikmin Bloom to join its Leadership Team and help shape the future of one of the world’s leading location-based live service games.
The Executive Producer owns execution across the game organization, enabling teams to consistently deliver exceptional player experiences through operational excellence, cross-functional leadership, and predictable execution. Working closely with the General Manager and functional leaders, this role establishes production practices, operating rhythms, and organizational processes that allow globally distributed teams to operate as One Team.
The Executive Producer owns execution across the game organization, enabling teams to consistently deliver exceptional player experiences through operational excellence, cross-functional leadership, and predictable execution. Working closely with the General Manager and functional leaders, this role establishes production practices, operating rhythms, and organizational processes that allow globally distributed teams—primarily across Japan and the United States—to operate as One Team.
From long-term roadmap planning to LiveOps execution, the Executive Producer ensures that strategy is translated into clear plans, teams remain aligned, risks are proactively managed, and the organization consistently delivers high-quality outcomes.
What You Will Do
Lead planning and execution across the game organization, ensuring timely, high-quality delivery of the product roadmap and LiveOps.
Partner closely with the General Manager and Leadership Team to translate the game’s vision and strategy into actionable roadmaps, milestones, and operating plans.
Establish world-class production practices, operating rhythms, and planning processes that improve transparency, predictability, and execution.
Create and foster a One Team mindset across Design, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Analytics, and external partners.
Build strong alignment across globally distributed teams, primarily across Japan and the United States, while maintaining efficient communication and clear ownership.
Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with key external partners, including major IP partners such as Nintendo, ensuring effective collaboration and alignment throughout development and live operations.
Develop and grow a high-performing Production organization that serves as a force multiplier for the entire game team.
Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the overall project, proactively identifying risks, removing organizational blockers, and driving timely decisions.
Ensure production supports player-centric development through iterative planning, playtesting, and continuous improvement.
Drive scalable production processes that support the long-term operation of a global live service game.
Provide clear visibility into project health, execution risks, and mitigation plans to senior leadership.
AI-Enabled Operational Excellence: Champion the adoption of AI-powered workflows that improve planning, communication, documentation, risk management, and production visibility. Continuously identify opportunities to automate routine work, accelerate execution, and increase the effectiveness of globally distributed teams.
Required in-office 3 days per week on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday
What We're Looking For
Proven experience leading production for a successful live service mobile game.
Demonstrated track record establishing production practices that improve execution across cross-functional teams.
Experience leading globally distributed development teams, including collaboration with external partners, including major IP partners.
Strong understanding of software development methodologies and modern game production practices.
Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills.
Exceptional ability to influence, align, and lead without direct authority.
Strong judgment with the ability to identify risks early and drive effective mitigation.
Demonstrated ability to design and implement AI-native workflows, custom tools, and automation that measurably improve planning, execution, and overall team efficiency.
Passion for building high-performing teams and healthy organizational culture.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Japanese
Plus if…
Experience leading production on a globally operated free-to-play mobile game.
Experience partnering with major entertainment or gaming IP holders.
Experience operating games with seasonal LiveOps, experimentation, and continuous content delivery.
Experience building or scaling Production organizations through periods of significant growth.
Familiarity with geolocation-based or outdoor gaming experiences.
Deep appreciation for player-first product development and long-term live service operations.
Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.
//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
Scopely Exploreでは、世界を代表する位置情報ライブサービスゲームのひとつであるPikmin Bloomの未来をともに創り上げるExecutive Producerを募集しています。本ポジションはLeadership Teamの一員として、ゲームの継続的な成長と成功をリードしていただきます。
Executive Producerは、ゲーム組織全体の**Execution（実行）**に責任を持ち、オペレーショナルエクセレンス、職能横断のリーダーシップ、そして予測可能な開発・運営を通じて、チームが継続的に優れたプレイヤー体験を提供できる環境を構築します。
General Managerおよび各部門のリーダーと密接に連携しながら、Productionプロセス、開発・運営リズム、組織運営の仕組みを整備し、日本と米国を中心としたグローバルに分散したチームがOne Teamとして機能できる組織づくりを推進していただきます。
長期的なロードマップ策定からLiveOpsの実行まで、ゲーム戦略を具体的な実行計画へと落とし込み、組織全体のアラインメントを維持しながら、リスクを先回りして管理し、高品質な成果を継続的に実現することがこのポジションのミッションです。
What You Will Do
ゲーム組織全体の計画立案および実行をリードし、プロダクトロードマップおよびLiveOpsを高い品質で計画通りに遂行する。
General ManagerおよびLeadership Teamと密接に連携し、ゲームのビジョンと戦略を実行可能なロードマップ、マイルストーン、および運営計画へと落とし込む。
透明性・予測可能性・実行力を高める世界水準のProductionプロセス、オペレーティングリズム、および計画手法を構築・改善する。
Design、Product、Engineering、Marketing、Analytics、および社外パートナーを横断し、One Teamのカルチャーを醸成する。
日本と米国を中心としたグローバルに分散したチーム間の強固なアラインメントを構築し、効率的なコミュニケーションと明確な責任分担を実現する。
Nintendoをはじめとする主要なIPパートナーを含む重要な外部パートナーと強固な信頼関係を構築・維持し、開発からLiveOpsまで一貫して円滑な協業とアラインメントを推進する。
ゲームチーム全体の成果を最大化するForce Multiplierとして機能する、高いパフォーマンスを発揮するProduction組織を構築・育成する。
プロジェクト全体の状況を常に把握し、リスクを早期に特定し、組織的な障害を取り除き、迅速な意思決定を推進する。
反復的な計画、プレイテスト、および継続的な改善を通じて、プレイヤー中心の開発プロセスを推進する。
グローバルなライブサービスゲームを長期的に運営するための、拡張性の高いProductionプロセスを構築・改善する。
プロジェクトの健全性、実行上のリスク、およびその対応策について、経営層へ透明性の高いレポーティングを行う。
AIを活用したオペレーショナルエクセレンスの推進： 計画立案、コミュニケーション、ドキュメント作成、リスク管理、およびProductionの可視化を向上させるAIワークフローの導入を推進する。定型業務の自動化、実行スピードの向上、そしてグローバルに分散したチーム全体の生産性向上に継続的に取り組む。
原則として毎週火・水・木曜日はオフィス勤務となります。
What We're Looking For

Produce recurring market-intelligence and competitive-pulse readouts that identify meaningful changes in the market and potential implications for Slate titles.
Incorporate learnings from market research, beta acquisition, creative and audience testing, soft launch, and other pre-launch signals into forecast assumptions.
Support regional opportunity sizing and geo strategy, including differences in acquisition cost, scale, organic potential, and market dynamics.
Maintain clear assumption logs, source documentation, version history, confidence levels, and open questions so forecasts are auditable and reusable.
Partner closely with Performance Marketing, Product, Strategic Marketing, Finance, Analytics, and other stakeholders to gather inputs and pressure-test assumptions.
Proactively identify gaps, risks, or inconsistencies in forecasts and surface them before they become downstream planning issues.
Support ad hoc Slate analyses and leadership requests with structured research, quantitative analysis, and clear first-pass readouts.
Help improve and standardize forecasting methodologies, benchmark libraries, and analytical processes across Slate over time.

Strong experience in performance marketing, growth, marketing analytics, strategy, market intelligence, or a similarly analytical role, ideally within mobile games, mobile apps, or another consumer digital business.
Strong understanding of mobile user acquisition fundamentals, including CPI, LTV, ROAS, retention, organic acquisition, channel mix, attribution, and marginal economics.
Excellent analytical skills and the ability to turn incomplete or ambiguous information into structured assumptions and useful recommendations.
Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills, including building and auditing analytical models, sensitivity analyses, and forecast frameworks.
Strong attention to detail and a high bar for
 
model integrity, source quality, and assumption validation.
Ability to independently pressure-test data and assumptions rather than accepting outputs at face value.
Experience working with multiple data sources, including internal performance data, third-party market intelligence tools, partner benchmarks, and competitive research.
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong cross-functional working style and comfort partnering with teams across Marketing, Product, Finance, Analytics, and leadership.
Curiosity about the games market and a desire to understand why titles grow, why acquisition economics differ, and how launch dynamics evolve over time.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and operate effectively with limited oversight.
Comfortable using AI and other analytical tools to accelerate research and analysis, while maintaining independent judgment and thoroughly validating outputs.

You are an avid gamer who understands products from a user’s perspective.
Direct experience forecasting or supporting the launch of mobile games or consumer apps.
Experience with tools such as Sensor Tower, data.ai, AppMagic, Looker, Appsflyer, Adjust, or similar platforms.

You will own the quality and operational health of this work from intake and prioritization through translation or transcreation, linguistic review, in-context quality assurance, stakeholder approvals, and launch readiness. You will partner closely with Product Marketing, Product Management, Game Design, Creative Production, Community, Social, Direct Marketing, Communications, Production, regional teams, and external language partners. You will also use advanced AI tools and thoughtfully designed workflows to improve scale, speed, and consistency, while maintaining rigorous human review, confidentiality, IP standards, and the quality expected of Pokémon GO.

Lead APAC localization strategy and operations. 
Own the end-to-end localization program for all player-facing Pokémon GO communications in APAC. Define how work is scoped, prioritized, resourced, routed, reviewed, approved, and delivered across languages and markets.
Own localization quality. 
Set and uphold standards for linguistic accuracy, terminology, tone of voice, cultural relevance, brand consistency, and in-context quality. Ensure localized communications faithfully convey player value while feeling natural and appropriate in each market.
Manage the localization lifecycle. 
Drive projects from early intake and source-readiness through translation or transcreation, review, linguistic QA, stakeholder approvals, final delivery, and post-launch follow-up. Maintain clear ownership, timing, dependencies, and escalation paths throughout.

Work closely with Product Marketing, Product Management, Game Design, Creative Production, Community, Social, Direct Marketing, Communications, Production, regional teams to plan localization early, clarify requirements, and ensure localized materials are ready for each market's launch.

Build scalable localization systems.

Improve process visibility and launch readiness.

Build repeatable AI-enabled processes while applying sound judgment around accuracy, confidentiality, IP, brand standards, and human review.

About the Role
We are looking for a Community Manager to strengthen and grow Pokémon GO's player community in India.
As a key growth market for Pokémon GO, India presents opportunities to expand our player community, build stronger engagement, and connect more players through meaningful in-game and real-world experiences.
This role will manage local community programs, organize and promote player events, develop our Community Ambassador network, and support marketing and communications initiatives that contribute to player engagement and market growth.
Working closely with APAC Marketing, Communications, Game teams, and external partners, the Community Manager will also translate player insights into actionable recommendations and explore AI-enabled solutions to improve the efficiency and impact of community operations.
What You’ll Do
1. Community Events & Activations
Plan, promote, and execute community events and local activations, including Community Days, seasonal campaigns, and key Pokémon GO moments.
Develop initiatives that encourage player participation, strengthen community connections, and extend Pokémon GO's reach to wider audiences.
Collaborate with internal teams, Community Ambassadors, and local partners to deliver engaging player experiences.
Coordinate local event partners, vendors, and program budgets, ensuring effective execution and alignment with relevant approval processes.
Evaluate event performance and identify opportunities to improve participation, player engagement, and business impact.
2. Community Programs & Ambassador Development
Develop and execute community programs that strengthen player engagement, loyalty, and long-term community growth.
Manage and grow the Community Ambassador program, supporting community leaders in building active, inclusive, and sustainable local player communities.
Identify opportunities to expand community reach through grassroots initiatives, player advocacy, and local partnerships, helping attract new and returning players.
Promote community programs and collaborate with Marketing and Game teams to support broader Pokémon GO initiatives and market growth objectives.
Monitor program performance, community feedback, and participation to identify opportunities for improvement.
3. Community Insights & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Gather and analyze player feedback, community sentiment, and program performance to identify trends and opportunities.
Translate community insights into actionable recommendations that support player engagement, retention, and market development.
Partner with India and APAC Marketing, Communications, Product, and Game teams to align community activities with business priorities.
Support local marketing campaigns, communications, and partnerships to strengthen Pokémon GO's presence in India.
4. AI & Operational Improvement
Leverage AI and automation to improve community workflows, including survey development, localization, feedback collection, and reporting.
Identify opportunities to simplify repetitive tasks and develop scalable processes that can be reused across APAC markets.
Explore and prototype practical AI-enabled solutions that improve efficiency and support better community decision-making.
Apply appropriate human judgment, quality control, and data protection practices when using AI tools.
What we’re looking for
6+ years of relevant experience in community management, gaming, consumer marketing, events, or related disciplines, including demonstrated ownership of community programs or local activations.
Proven ability to independently manage community programs, player events, or grassroots marketing initiatives.
Strong understanding of gaming communities, player engagement, and how community programs can contribute to business growth.
Experience working with community leaders, ambassadors, creators, or external partners.
Strong project management, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Ability to analyze community feedback and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
Comfortable using AI tools and exploring automation to improve day-to-day workflows.
Knowledge of the Indian gaming market and local player communities.
Excellent written and spoken English; additional Indian languages are an advantage.
Passion for Pokémon GO and building meaningful player experiences.
What Success Looks Like
Community Growth:
 Stronger community participation and expanded reach across priority cities in India.
Player Engagement:
 Effective community events and programs that encourage ongoing participation and help attract new and returning players.
Program Development:
 A healthy, active Community Ambassador network that strengthens local player communities.
Business Contribution:
 Community insights and initiatives that inform marketing decisions and support India's growth objectives.
Operational Excellence:
 More efficient, scalable community processes through AI, automation, and continuous improvement.
